purpose: Deterministic keyword lists driving PUE Evidence extraction for the GPU domain (product form, product type, compatibility, exclusion, bundle, condition, and desktop/mobile terms). Consumed by digital_arbitrage.pue.evidence.load_terms.
change_note: Sprint 3 GPU release benchmark (gpu_release_benchmark_v0.1.json) found two narrow, labelled-case-justified gaps, both fixed here: (1) cases exact_23/24/25_*arc*, family_only_03_arca770, family_only_08_arca750 - the 'intel arc' brand alias claimed character span (0,9) in every 'Intel Arc A7xx ...' title, overlapping and blocking the 'arc a770'/'arc a750' family-alias span checked later (evidence.py extracts brand before family, and a taken span is never reconsidered - see evidence.py's documented category-precedence ordering); every Intel Arc listing was therefore emitted with a brand_token but no product_family_token at all, and Decision Formation correctly-but-wrongly concluded OUTSIDE_SUPPORTED_DOMAIN for a real, in-catalogue GPU family. Fixed by removing 'intel arc' from brand_aliases ('intel' alone is already sufficient to detect the brand; the family alias list already contains 'arc a770'/'intel arc a770' etc. and is now free to match). (2) cases fan_03_cooling_fans_for_rtx4090 and bracket_04_gpu_support_stand - a mandatory release-gate-relevant accessory_to_complete_product harmful error: 'cooling fans' (plural) and 'support stand'/'card holder' phrasing had no matching accessory term, so these accessory listings fell through to a complete_product hypothesis. Fixed by adding the missing plural/phrasing variants to gpu_fan and gpu_bracket. Both fixes are single-entry/single-list additions, each justified by specific failing benchmark cases, and covered by tests/pue/test_invariants.py plus the Sprint 3 benchmark re-run (see PUE_v0.1_SPRINT3_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md).
license_note: Hand-authored deterministic term lists. No external dataset imported.
